Name: Valley of cats
Author: astrid23
Description:
this mod was inspired by the catdewvalley mod 

almost everyone's Sprite has been edited to have cat ears (no one with hats yet)

i have added cat ears to all "outfits" ie Normal, beach and winter

any issues please tell me and ill try to sort them out

this is my first mod so may have slight issues

thats it, thats the mod, cat ears


Future plans

1, finish work on the rest of the valley (including a separate smaller file for juminos, slimes, ect)
2, Add portraits with cat ears 
3, Add all this for other mods including SVE, RSV, TDIT
